purpose: Frozen high-level Protocol B1 input: official benchmark objective and goal semantics only. No task decomposition, no agent/Node assignment, no DAG, no oracle solution, no pre-authored MissionPlan.
instruction: Two heterogeneous robots (a legged Spot and a wheeled Fetch) operate in one shared multi-floor scene. Complete the benchmark objective: ensure that a robot reaches the object any_targets|0, and ensure that a robot reaches the goal receptacle position TARGET_any_targets|0. Decide yourselves how to divide the work between the available robots and carry it out.
